keyVerseDR: "For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also." (Lk 12:34)

level1.title: Be Ready
level1.story: Jesus said, "Do not be afraid, little flock. Where your treasure is, your heart will be too." Be like servants waiting with lamps lit for their master.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you be ready for Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are my treasure. Amen.

activity.title: My treasure
activity.intro: Color 10 beads and pray a Hail Mary for each.
activity.label: My treasure is Jesus

level2.title: Faithful Servants
level2.story: Jesus said, "Fear not, little flock, for it hath pleased your Father to give you a kingdom." He told them to make purses that do not grow old, a treasure in heaven. "For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also." Jesus said to be like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding, with lamps burning. He said, "Be you then also ready: for at what hour you think not, the Son of man will come."
level2.keyLine: Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does your heart treasure most?
What has God given you to care for?
actions: Store treasure in heaven with a kind act
level2.prayer: Lord, make me a faithful servant. Amen.

activity.title: Say it in one line
activity.intro: Think about the Gospel, then open to read a summary.
activity.question: Can you tell today's Gospel in one sentence?
activity.answer: Store up treasure in heaven and stay ready like servants with lamps lit for their master.

art.mainBrief: Servants with lamps waiting for master; treasure
